battle_result_processed_occurred.meaning: a single battle result has been processed by battleElo and Elo.ratingChange was called to obtain change and negative

negative_is_true.meaning: the negative flag returned by Elo.ratingChange is true, signifying eloB's rating should decrease

negative_is_false.meaning: the negative flag returned by Elo.ratingChange is false, indicating eloB's rating should increase

better_party_rating_decreased.meaning: the party that performs better or wins sees its Elo rating decrease after the update

worse_party_rating_increased.meaning: the party that performs worse or loses sees its Elo rating increase after the update

dependent_data_incorrect.meaning: protocol functionality relying on the calculated Elo ratings operates on entirely incorrect data, yielding distorted rankings, unfair matchmaking and mismatched rewards

assumptions: battleElo is the only path that applies the change and negative values to the simulated eloA and eloB scores.
The better-performing party is identified by the battle outcome, not by the sign of the returned change value.
Downstream protocol functionality (rankings, matchmaking, rewards, eligibility) consumes the simulated Elo ratings produced by battleElo.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric elo values or change amounts, so the magnitude of the rating adjustment cannot be bound; only the direction relation is formalized.
Report does not state who invokes battleElo or any authorization condition, so no caller qualifier is encoded in the condition.

limitations: The selected impact severe_consequences is a potential downstream consequence; its predicate is a grounded Boolean over the report's stated incorrect-data outcome rather than a numeric ranking/reward relation.
Direction of adjustment is formalized qualitatively because the report supplies no numeric elo or change values.
Only the severe_consequences impact is formalized here; direction_inverted and dependent_functions_wrong_data are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
